brief: Recognize financial coercion and identify a safe support option without requiring confrontation.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Financial Coercion"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Reconoce coerción financiera"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Reconheça coação com dinheiro"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Recognize financial coercion and identify a safe support option without requiring confrontation.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Money can be used to control someone; recognize pressure and choose support that respects their immediate safety.
instruction.misconception: Coerced debt is normal sharing, or seeking help always requires confronting the controlling person first.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: Forced debt or blocked money access can signal coercion. Seek trusted support through a safe channel; confrontation is not required.
Threats remove the freedom to choose the debt.
A safer channel reduces exposure while seeking support.
Punitive restriction uses money to control another person.
Support does not require risking confrontation first.
Support should preserve safety and the person’s choices.
Threat-based control warrants support that prioritizes safety.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.

en-US.line: Money can be used to control someone; recognize pressure and choose support that respects their immediate safety.

en-US.scene: A partner threatens harm unless another signs a loan they do not want.
help: Distinguish consent from pressure backed by threats.

feedback.met: Threats remove the freedom to choose the debt.
feedback.not_yet: Distinguish consent from pressure backed by threats.

feedback.not_yet: Distingue consentimiento de presión con amenazas.
